name: monoswitch
description: One display, two computers. A local-first Chrome extension and Rust DDC bridge.

scripts.test: npm --prefix extension test && cargo test --locked --manifest-path native/Cargo.toml && cargo test --locked --manifest-path setup/Cargo.toml && node --test scripts/*.test.mjs
scripts.check: npm run build:extension && cargo clippy --locked --manifest-path native/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo clippy --locked --manifest-path setup/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings
